BashTutorial.speaker: TUTOR
BashTutorial.text: We begin with standard Bash. We alternate turns, removing 1, 2, or 3 units from the shared total. Only legal quantities remain available.

BashTutorial.speaker: TUTOR
BashTutorial.text: The terminal rule is the important one: whoever takes the final unit loses immediately. Near the end, distinguish a legal move from a safe move.

BashTutorial.speaker: TUTOR
BashTutorial.text: You act first in round one; I act first in round two. You must complete both rounds. An unsuccessful result restarts only the current round, not the full introduction.

bash_round_start.speaker: TUTOR
bash_round_start.text: Round parameters are stable. Count forward to the terminal position before you commit.

bash_round_start.speaker: TUTOR
bash_round_start.text: Observation has begun. I will act only after the current choice is confirmed.

bash_round_start.speaker: TUTOR
bash_round_start.text: Treat the remaining units as a sequence, S-17. The last action determines the result.

bash_player_confirmed.speaker: TUTOR
bash_player_confirmed.text: Choice registered. Control now passes to me.

bash_player_confirmed.speaker: TUTOR
bash_player_confirmed.text: Input accepted. The shared state has been updated.

bash_player_confirmed.speaker: TUTOR
bash_player_confirmed.text: Your action is confirmed. I am evaluating the legal replies.

bash_tutor_acted.speaker: TUTOR
bash_tutor_acted.text: My action is complete. Reassess the remaining sequence.

bash_tutor_acted.speaker: TUTOR
bash_tutor_acted.text: Your turn, S-17. The board state is stable.

bash_tutor_acted.speaker: TUTOR
bash_tutor_acted.text: Control is yours. Accuracy is more useful here than speed.

bash_terminal_approach.speaker: TUTOR
bash_terminal_approach.text: The terminal range is close. Remember: taking the final unit loses.

bash_terminal_approach.speaker: TUTOR
bash_terminal_approach.text: Only a few units remain. A legal action is not necessarily a safe action.

bash_terminal_approach.speaker: TUTOR
bash_terminal_approach.text: Trace the next reply before confirming. The end condition now dominates the sequence.

limit_game_start.speaker: TUTOR
limit_game_start.text: A new simultaneous-choice trial is initialized. Your selection remains hidden until both sides are ready.

limit_game_start.speaker: TUTOR
limit_game_start.text: New game state confirmed. Track both the remainder and our previous choices.

limit_game_start.speaker: TUTOR
limit_game_start.text: Limit Bash is active. Choose privately; the protocol will reveal both decisions together.

limit_choice_locked.speaker: TUTOR
limit_choice_locked.text: Choice locked. I am selecting from the same legal range.

limit_choice_locked.speaker: TUTOR
limit_choice_locked.text: Commitment accepted. Reveal will occur when both choices are fixed.

limit_choice_locked.speaker: TUTOR
limit_choice_locked.text: Your decision can no longer be changed. My response is now being finalized.

limit_reveal.speaker: TUTOR
limit_reveal.text: Both choices are public. Compare the new remainder before proceeding.

limit_reveal.speaker: TUTOR
limit_reveal.text: Reveal complete. This pair is now part of the game's decision history.

limit_reveal.speaker: TUTOR
limit_reveal.text: The pair has been resolved. Any next choice must differ from your previous one.

limit_terminal_approach.speaker: TUTOR
limit_terminal_approach.text: Terminal range reached. If our total meets the remainder, the larger choice loses.

limit_terminal_approach.speaker: TUTOR
limit_terminal_approach.text: The next reveal may settle the game. Equal choices will be resolved from the recorded history.

limit_terminal_approach.speaker: TUTOR
limit_terminal_approach.text: At this distance, apply the terminal comparison rule rather than ordinary subtraction.

restore.speaker: TUTOR
restore.text: Stable checkpoint restored. The protocol may continue from the displayed state.

restore.speaker: TUTOR
restore.text: Session reconstruction complete. Rule state and prior results passed integrity checks.

restore.speaker: TUTOR
restore.text: The active evaluation has resumed. Review the current state before confirming.

result_player_win.speaker: TUTOR
result_player_win.text: Evaluation recorded: successful. The result is valid; continue when your review is complete.

result_player_win.speaker: TUTOR
result_player_win.text: This game is complete. Your method reached a successful terminal state.

result_player_win.speaker: TUTOR
result_player_win.text: Success confirmed, S-17. One result is evidence, not a complete model; proceed when ready.

result_player_lose.speaker: TUTOR
result_player_lose.text: Evaluation recorded: unsuccessful. Review the terminal condition before continuing.

result_player_lose.speaker: TUTOR
result_player_lose.text: This game is complete. The failed state is stable and has been recorded without penalty to the protocol.

result_player_lose.speaker: TUTOR
result_player_lose.text: The current attempt did not satisfy the objective. The next state will begin only when you continue.

result_draw.speaker: TUTOR
result_draw.text: Evaluation recorded: draw. Neither side established a decisive difference.

result_draw.speaker: TUTOR
result_draw.text: The game resolved evenly across its recorded history. The draw is valid.

result_draw.speaker: TUTOR
result_draw.text: No losing line was established. Repeating that stability may satisfy the alternate completion condition.
